source: Shopify abandoned checkouts + Meta demographics + first-party session events

abandoned_checkouts.note: Checkout abandonment uses Shopify abandoned checkouts plus paid-order checkout exposures by product.

meta_demographics.note: Gender is aggregate platform reporting, not user-level gender.

meta_payment.source: Meta AddPaymentInfo by ad and country
meta_payment.note: Immediate submit-payment abandonment uses Meta AddPaymentInfo minus purchases by ad/country. Exact product/session rows are added when the Shopify session pixel posts payment_info_submitted.

session_events.note: Payment-submit, dwell, and non-purchaser journeys become real after the pixel posts events to /api/session-events.

scoring.method: Bayesian shrinkage toward site average plus support-weighted excess abandons
scoring.checkout_window: No paid order/recovery in selected window; Shopify abandoned checkout completed_at is treated as recovered.
scoring.submit_payment_window: No checkout_completed within 2 hours after payment_info_submitted.
